Holographic Command Centre Architecture

You are viewing NOVA — Holographic Command Centre, inspired by cinematic holographic sci-fi dashboards.

Command Centre Subsystems:

  • Central Circular Holographic Reactor: Layered Three.js nucleus, 3 independently rotating segmented rings, 72 procedural radial ticks, and tilted orbital beacon assembly.
  • Balanced 4-Panel Matrix: Sessions Archive & Acoustic Synthesis on left; Live Telemetry & Quick Operations on right.
  • Expandable Conversation Stream: Keeps default dashboard clean and focused on the reactor while providing full rich chat & syntax-highlighted code with copy buttons when expanded.
  • Acoustic Telemetry: Live voice velocity control, persona selection, and Web Speech API synthesis with manual stop controls.

Connecting to Node.js/Express:

Responses are currently generated locally by src/services/apiAdapter.js. Set isDemoMode = false and point to your POST /api/chat endpoint to connect a real backend.
